descriptions.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
descriptions.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

sections.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
sections.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

descriptions.zh: 在一颗被风暴毁灭的星球中埋葬于废墟之下的庇护所：外部的残破使其难以调查，但内部似乎还是完好的。
descriptions.en: A shelter buried under the debris of a storm-ravaged world; the devastation is making it hard to investigate, but the interior appears intact.

sections.zh: 在一颗被风暴毁灭的星球中埋葬于废墟之下的庇护所：外部的残破使其难以调查，但内部似乎还是完好的。
sections.en: A shelter buried under the debris of a storm-ravaged world; the devastation is making it hard to investigate, but the interior appears intact.

descriptions.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
descriptions.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Traders would have lived, eons ago. Why these coordinates were securely stored in a storm shelter will need to be investigated.

Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Traders would have lived, eons ago. Why these coordinates were securely stored in a storm shelter will need to be investigated.

descriptions.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!，这是因内特贸易体的一颗工业星球。从其上现存的建筑来看，这颗行星显然不是用来居住的。然而，我们仍不能确定其上的工厂究竟是用于生产什么的。
descriptions.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!, an industrial world from the Inetian Traders' empire. Based on the existing architecture, this was clearly not a residential planet. However, it remains uncertain what exactly its industrial might was meant to produce.

Based on the existing architecture, this was clearly not a residential planet. However, it remains uncertain what exactly its industrial might was meant to produce.

descriptions.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!。它的地表除了积雪和灰尘以外几乎什么也没有，初步扫描发现这颗行星曾一度是宜居的。不知这颗已经化为废墟的行星在过去是否对因内特贸易体有重要意义呢？
descriptions.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!. The surface is little more than snow and dust, but initial scans show that the planet was once habitable. Was it important to the Inetian Traders before or after its ruin?

sections.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!。它的地表除了积雪和灰尘以外几乎什么也没有，初步扫描发现这颗行星曾一度是宜居的。不知这颗已经化为废墟的行星在过去是否对因内特贸易体有重要意义呢？
sections.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!. The surface is little more than snow and dust, but initial scans show that the planet was once habitable. Was it important to the Inetian Traders before or after its ruin?

descriptions.zh: 在局部扰动抑制器的控制台中保存着一个数据信号。虽然有些难度，但我们能复制它的模式，并且在全星系中搜寻匹配。航迹引向了一颗不可宜居的星球。是时候弄明白因内特贸易体瞄准着什么，以及为什么瞄准了。
descriptions.en: Saved within the command console of the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors was a data signal. Though difficult, we were able to clone its pattern and search the galaxy for a match. The trail led to an uninhabited planet. It is time to discover what the Inetian Traders were targeting, and why.

sections.zh: 在局部扰动抑制器的控制台中保存着一个数据信号。虽然有些难度，但我们能复制它的模式，并且在全星系中搜寻匹配。航迹引向了一颗不可宜居的星球。是时候弄明白因内特贸易体瞄准着什么，以及为什么瞄准了。
sections.en: Saved within the command console of the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors was a data signal. Though difficult, we were able to clone its pattern and search the galaxy for a match. The trail led to an uninhabited planet. It is time to discover what the Inetian Traders were targeting, and why.

descriptions.zh: 因内特贸易体试图保护这个恒星系中的一座小小的空间站不受星尘沙暴的影响。而这个风暴则始料未及地发育增强并且摧毁了许多其他的恒星系。为什么他们要如此费尽心机地保护这座设施呢？
descriptions.en: The Inetian Traders tried to protect a space station within this system from a small celestial dust storm. As an unforeseen consequence, the storm grew so large several other of their systems were destroyed. Why were they so desperate to protect this facility?

sections.zh: 因内特贸易体试图保护这个恒星系中的一座小小的空间站不受星尘沙暴的影响。而这个风暴则始料未及地发育增强并且摧毁了许多其他的恒星系。为什么他们要如此费尽心机地保护这座设施呢？
sections.en: The Inetian Traders tried to protect a space station within this system from a small celestial dust storm. As an unforeseen consequence, the storm grew so large several other of their systems were destroyed. Why were they so desperate to protect this facility?

descriptions.zh: 这座古老的通讯站仍可工作。登上这座站点并直接与其系统交互后，我们也许就能破译此前收到的广播。
descriptions.en: This ancient communication station is still active. By boarding the site and directly interfacing with its systems we might be able to decipher its previous broadcasts.

sections.zh: 这座古老的通讯站仍可工作。登上这座站点并直接与其系统交互后，我们也许就能破译此前收到的广播。
sections.en: This ancient communication station is still active. By boarding the site and directly interfacing with its systems we might be able to decipher its previous broadcasts.

descriptions.zh: 尽管宇宙风暴一般是破坏性的，但这场风暴却成为发现外星文明存在证据的契机。尽管这颗行星的大气极不稳定，然而登陆队可能会揭示这个古老文化的可怕命运。
descriptions.en: As destructive as cosmic storms can be, this one uncovered evidence an alien civilization. Though the planet's atmosphere is incredibly unstable, a landing party might reveal whatever horrible fate befell this ancient culture.

sections.zh: 尽管宇宙风暴一般是破坏性的，但这场风暴却成为发现外星文明存在证据的契机。尽管这颗行星的大气极不稳定，然而登陆队可能会揭示这个古老文化的可怕命运。
sections.en: As destructive as cosmic storms can be, this one uncovered evidence an alien civilization. Though the planet's atmosphere is incredibly unstable, a landing party might reveal whatever horrible fate befell this ancient culture.

descriptions.zh: 这个地区奇怪的能量波动掩盖着一座巨大的海军墓地。这座由聚合物和金属组成的墓地可能藏有了解阿达卡利亚公约的重要线索。
descriptions.en: The strange energy fluctuations in this area obscured a massive naval graveyard. This necropolis of polymer and metal may harbor a vital clue to understanding the adAkkaria Convention.

sections.zh: 这个地区奇怪的能量波动掩盖着一座巨大的海军墓地。这座由聚合物和金属组成的墓地可能藏有了解阿达卡利亚公约的重要线索。
sections.en: The strange energy fluctuations in this area obscured a massive naval graveyard. This necropolis of polymer and metal may harbor a vital clue to understanding the adAkkaria Convention.

descriptions.zh:
这座由阿达卡利亚公约建造的古老居住站环绕着一颗荒芜的星球。其高质量的建筑材料使空间站保留了近乎原始的状态。

调到传输频率上之后，我们收到一条信息，后面跟着一段浮夸的铃铛声：§L欢迎来到崇高仁善爱国协会§!。
descriptions.en:
Orbiting a desolate planet, this ancient habitat was built by the adAkkaria Convention. The high quality building materials used in its construction have ensured the station is in near pristine condition.

Tuning into the transmission frequency, we picked up a single message, followed by a bombastic jingle: §LWelcome to the Patriotic Institute of Exalted Benevolence§!.

descriptions.zh:
在与宇宙风暴通信之后，艾德苏尔我们展示出了自己的一小部分。在残云之间矗立着一座巨大的建筑群。这里早已遭到遗弃，但奇怪的是它并没有受到时间的影响，扫描显示它的内部存在有机物质。

在这座巨大的建筑前升起了一系列横幅，上面写着同一句话：庆典时刻到。
descriptions.en:
After the communication with the cosmic storm, a small part of adSul was revealed to us. Between the remnant clouds stood a massive complex. Abandoned, yet strangely unaffected by the eons, scans reveal organic material on the inside.

Rising before the immense building were a series of banners bearing a single proclamation: It Is Time for Celebration.

descriptions.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
descriptions.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

sections.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

descriptions.zh: 紧随着最近过境的§Y电力风暴§!，在§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
descriptions.en: Following the passing of a recent §YElectric Storm§!, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators were reactivated by the storm, bringing the facility back online.
